exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Noun wo kureru (to give to me/someone close)".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない
名詞 を くれる

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 名詞 を くれる matches "Noun wo kureru (to give to me/someone close)".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 名詞 を くれる.
exercises.explanation: Used when someone gives something to the speaker or someone close.
